title: Dreams outside of MallWorld
content: My dreams are in mallworld 99% of the time. I know the map of everything and can use public transit/ roads in my dream to get around. I had a dream last night in a different area and it feels so strange and significant. Nothing that important happened but it was a hotel and different bridge and streets than I have in my usual map. Have you guys left mall world, or do you only visit occasionally?
